name: Pernicar
description: Pernicar was the first planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a scorching rock.
lead_paragraphs: Pernicar was the first planet orbiting the star Hoth's Brand in the Ruusan system. Located in the Teraab sector of the Mid Rim, it was a scorching rock.
It was named after the Jedi Master Pernicar.
